1

The petitioners seek for quashing of the FIR in Crime No.541 of 2023 on the file of the first respondent for the alleged offences under Section 406 & 420 of IPC.
2.

The allegation in the impugned FIR is that the petitioners came to the shop of the defacto complainant and handed over a chain weighing about 36.770 grams and stating that it is made of gold and received another chain weighing 23.270 grams of gold and Rs.8,500/-.
Later, the defacto complainant came to know that the jewels given by the petitioners were fake.

3. The learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that the petitioners are not habitual offenders and the parties have arrived at a compromise and hence, the FIR registered against the petitioners may be quashed.
4. Admittedly, the petitioners and the second respondent have now entered into a compromise and decided to give a quietus to the entire dispute.
The parties have filed a joint compromise memo dated 22.09.2025.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 21/11/2025 11:13:02 am )

The 1st petitioner, namely, Sankareswari (Aadhaar No.9203 5736 4367), 2nd petitioner, namely,
Vijayalakshmi (Aadhaar No.9852 7694 4190) and the defacto complainant, namely, Krishnan (Aadhaar No.9463 1007 8733) are present before this Court in person.
They are identified by Mr.P.Sivakumar, Special Sub Inspector of Police, Thirumangalam Town Police Station, Madurai District.

entities.text: Thirumangalam Town Police Station, Madurai District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: All the parties confirmed the compromise arrived at between them.

6. Considering the nature of the offences; that the parties have arrived at compromise; that the dispute is private in nature; and that the defacto complainant is not interested in pursuing the FIR,
this Court is of the view that no useful purpose would be served in keeping the impugned FIR pending investigation.
Accordingly, the impugned FIR in Crime No.541 of 2023 dated 21.11.2023 is quashed and the Criminal Original Petition stands allowed.
The joint compromise memo dated 22.09.2025 shall form part of this order.

The petitioners shall pay a sum of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand only) as costs to the Mediation Centre attached to this Bench forthwith and file a photocopy of the receipt along with a memo reporting compliance in the Registry.
